transfer--noun.def: The act of moving someone or something to another place.
transfer--noun.ex: He asked for a transfer to Izmir.

seal--noun.def: An official mark pressed into wax, or a sea animal.
seal--noun.ex: The letter carries a royal seal.

standard--adj.def: Usual and accepted rather than special.

confession--noun.def: A statement admitting that you did something wrong.

frankly--adv.def: Honestly and directly, even if it is unwelcome.
frankly--adv.ex: Frankly, the plan will not work.

principal--noun.def: The head of a school or a college.

underground--adj.def: Below the surface of the earth, or secret and illegal.

underground--adv.def: Below the surface of the ground.

identify--verb.def: To recognize someone, or to say exactly what something is.
identify--verb.ex: She identified the bird by its call.

chip--noun.def: A small piece of silicon in a computer, or a fried potato slice.
chip--noun.ex: The card contains a small chip.
chip--noun.exTr: Kartın içinde küçük bir çip var.

surveillance--noun.def: The careful watching of a person or a place.

underneath--adv.def: Under something, especially hidden by it.
underneath--adv.ex: Look underneath and you will see it.

tribe--noun.def: A group of people sharing language, customs and ancestors.
tribe--noun.ex: The tribe moves with the seasons.

deputy--noun.def: The person directly below the leader in rank.
deputy--noun.ex: The deputy signed in her absence.

headquarters--noun.def: The main office of a company or an army.

equal--noun.def: A person of the same rank or ability as another.
equal--noun.ex: She treats him as an equal.

equal--verb.def: To be the same in amount or value.

reckon--verb.def: To think or to calculate, in informal speech.
reckon--verb.ex: I reckon we will arrive by noon.

related--adj.def: Connected to something, or from the same family.
related--adj.ex: The two cases are clearly related.

nerve--noun.def: A fibre that carries signals in the body, or courage.

stake--noun.def: Something valuable you risk, or a share in a business.

landing--noun.def: The act of coming down to the ground, or a floor area on stairs.

traitor--noun.def: A person who betrays their country or friends.

outfit--noun.def: A set of clothes worn together.

costume--noun.def: Clothes worn by actors or in a tradition.
costume--noun.ex: Each dancer had a red costume.
costume--noun.exTr: Her dansçının kırmızı bir kostümü vardı.

injured--adj.def: Hurt in an accident or an attack.

aim--verb.def: To point a weapon, or to try to achieve something.
aim--verb.ex: We aim to finish by Friday.

environment--noun.def: The natural world, or the conditions you live in.

western--adj.def: In or from the west of a place.
western--adj.ex: Western Turkey is milder in winter.

ease--noun.def: The state of doing something without difficulty.

ease--verb.def: To make pain or a problem less serious.

starving--adj.def: Suffering from a lack of food, or very hungry.
starving--adj.ex: I am starving after that walk.

timing--noun.def: The choice of the right moment to do something.

skip--verb.def: To leave something out, or to jump lightly.

conscience--noun.def: The inner sense of what is right and wrong.

determined--adj.def: Having decided firmly and not willing to stop.

hail--verb.def: To call out to someone to attract their attention.
hail--verb.ex: He hailed a taxi in the rain.

booth--noun.def: A small closed space for one person.

packed--adj.def: Completely full of people or things.
packed--adj.ex: The bus was packed this morning.

trunk--noun.def: The main stem of a tree, a car's boot, or an elephant's nose.
trunk--noun.ex: The trunk of the oak is huge.

backup--noun.def: A copy of data, or extra help if needed.
backup--noun.ex: Keep a backup of the files.

benefit--verb.def: To be helped by something, or to help someone.
benefit--verb.ex: Small farms benefit from the grant.

territory--noun.def: Land under the control of a country or an animal.

comment--verb.def: To give your opinion about something.

frame--verb.def: To put a picture in a frame, or to make an innocent person seem guilty.

strip--verb.def: To remove a covering or clothes.
strip--verb.ex: They stripped the old paint off.

laundry--noun.def: Clothes that need washing, or the place they are washed.

lousy--adj.ex: We had lousy weather all week.
lousy--adj.exTr: Bütün hafta berbat bir hava vardı.

individual--noun.def: One person, considered separately from a group.

tattoo--noun.def: A permanent picture made on the skin with ink.
tattoo--noun.ex: He has a small tattoo on his arm.

precisely--adv.def: Exactly, with no difference at all.
precisely--adv.ex: The train left at precisely nine.

underwear--noun.def: Clothes worn next to the skin under other clothes.
underwear--noun.ex: Pack enough underwear for a week.

relief--noun.def: The good feeling when trouble ends, or help for people in need.
relief--noun.ex: It was a relief to hear her voice.

pulse--noun.def: The regular beat of blood through the body.

pitch--noun.def: A sports field, or how high or low a sound is.
pitch--noun.ex: The pitch was wet after the rain.

pitch--verb.def: To put up a tent, or to throw a ball.
pitch--verb.ex: We pitched the tent by the stream.

hammer--verb.def: To hit something with a hammer.
hammer--verb.ex: He hammered the post into the ground.

helicopter--noun.def: An aircraft that flies with turning blades above it.
helicopter--noun.ex: A helicopter landed in the field.

slap--noun.def: A hit with the flat of the hand.
slap--noun.ex: The slap was heard across the room.

slap--verb.def: To hit someone with the flat of your hand.

photograph--verb.def: To take a picture with a camera.

offense--noun.def: A crime, or something that upsets people.

snap--verb.def: To break suddenly with a sharp sound, or to speak angrily.

hood--noun.def: A head covering joined to a coat, or a car's front cover.
hood--noun.ex: Pull your hood up in the rain.

technically--adv.def: According to the exact rules or facts.
technically--adv.ex: Technically, the shop is still open.

profile--noun.def: A side view of a face, or a short description of someone.

shed--noun.def: A small building used for storing tools.
shed--noun.ex: The spades are in the shed.

rocket--noun.def: A vehicle or a weapon driven by burning fuel.
rocket--noun.ex: The rocket lifted off at dawn.

gambling--noun.def: The activity of risking money on a game or a race.

procedure--noun.def: The official way of doing something, step by step.

investigate--verb.def: To try to find out the truth about something.

chop--verb.def: To cut something into pieces with a knife or an axe.

commercial--noun.def: An advertisement on television or radio.

engagement--noun.def: An agreement to marry, or an arranged meeting.

transport--verb.def: To carry people or goods from one place to another.

creepy--adj.def: Making you feel nervous and slightly afraid.
